workoutSession.notFoundDescription: Unable to load workout session. Please try again.
workoutSession.ovulationInsight: During ovulation, you may experience increased strength and performance.
workoutSession.menstrualInsight: During menstruation, you may need to reduce intensity and focus on recovery.
workoutSession.lowFuelingMessage: You've consumed only {{carbs}}g of carbs in the last {{hours}} hours. Glycogen stores might be low. For future sessions, aim for more carbs pre-workout. A quick snack now might still help your performance.
workoutSession.fullyFueledMessage: You've consumed {{carbs}}g of carbs in the last {{hours}} hours. You are fully fueled and ready to crush it!
workoutSession.missingDataDescription: Could not load the current exercise. Check the overview or finish the session.

adjustment.carryOver: Weight follows your last set ({{to}} {{unit}}) instead of the planned {{from}} {{unit}}.
adjustment.targetRirWeight: Weight changed from {{from}} to {{to}} {{unit}} — your last set puts your estimated 1RM at {{oneRepMax}} {{unit}}, so this keeps {{rir}} reps in reserve.
adjustment.targetRirReps: Reps changed from {{from}} to {{to}} — your last set puts your estimated 1RM at {{oneRepMax}} {{unit}}, so this keeps {{rir}} reps in reserve at the current weight.
adjustment.startProgressionWeight: Up to {{to}} {{unit}} from last time's {{last}} {{unit}} — you had about {{rir}} reps in reserve.
adjustment.startProgressionWeightReps: Up to {{to}} {{unit}} × {{reps}} from last time's {{last}} {{unit}} × {{lastReps}} — you had about {{rir}} reps in reserve.
adjustment.startProgressionReps: One more rep than last time ({{to}}, not {{last}}) — you had about {{rir}} reps in reserve.
adjustment.startDeload: Down to {{to}} {{unit}} from last time's {{last}} {{unit}} — two sessions in a row with no reps left in reserve.
adjustment.startRepeatWeight: Starting at {{to}} {{unit}}, what you used last time, instead of the plan's {{from}} {{unit}}.
adjustment.startRepeatReps: Starting at {{to}} reps, what you did last time, instead of the plan's {{from}}.
adjustment.startDeloadWeightReps: Down to {{to}} {{unit}} × {{reps}} from last time's {{last}} {{unit}} × {{lastReps}} — two sessions in a row with no reps left in reserve.
adjustment.startRepeatWeightReps: Starting at {{to}} {{unit}} × {{reps}}, what you did last time, instead of the plan's {{from}} {{unit}} × {{planReps}}.
adjustment.startReviewLighter: Lighter week from your Weekly Review: {{weight}} {{unit}} × {{reps}}.
adjustment.startReviewRepeat: Repeating last session, from your Weekly Review: {{weight}} {{unit}} × {{reps}}.

notes.title: Notes
notes.thisWorkoutPlaceholder: How it felt, what to change next set
notes.alsoTemplateHint: Next time you start this workout, the note is already there.
notes.alwaysPlaceholder: A cue for every workout, e.g. elbows tucked
notes.alwaysHint: Shown above the set whenever you do this exercise.
notes.failed: Couldn't save the notes. Please try again.

firstTip.title: How a session works
firstTip.inline: Type your weight and reps, then tap ✓ to log the set. Tap “Last time” to repeat those numbers.
firstTip.guided: Adjust weight and reps with − and +, then tap Complete set.
firstTip.common: The rest timer starts after each set. Warm-up sets are marked W and don’t count toward your volume or records.

progression.resetTm: Reset TM and estimate from history
progression.editorHint: This rule belongs to the workout. Weight and rep edits during training affect that session only.
progression.followRule: Follow your rule using these targets.
progression.learningHint: Log a workout to build history for future recommendations.

range.add_weight: Every prescribed set reached {{repMax}} reps. Add one load step and restart at {{repMin}}.
range.add_reps: Aim for one more rep than the corresponding set last time, within {{repMin}}–{{repMax}}.
range.hold: Keep this load and work within {{repMin}}–{{repMax}} reps.
range.deload: Two sessions in a row at this load missed {{repMin}} reps. Reduce one load step.

linear.add_weight: All prescribed reps were completed. Add one load step for {{reps}} reps.
linear.hold: Repeat this load. {{failures}} of {{failuresBeforeDeload}} consecutive misses before a deload.
linear.deload: {{failures}} consecutive misses at this load: reduce it by {{deloadPercent}}%.

reason.backoff: Use {{percent}}% of the top set ({{top}} {{unit}}), rounded to available equipment.
reason.percentage: Use {{percent}}% of the retained training max ({{tm}} {{unit}}).
reason.ceiling: You’ve reached {{ceiling}} reps. To keep progressing, add load (a weighted vest or dip belt), switch to a harder variation, or slow the tempo.
reason.percentageLowered: {{failures}} sessions in a row missed reps, so the training max was lowered by {{resetPercent}}% to {{tm}} {{unit}}. Use {{percent}}% of it.

summary.percentageNoTm: Training max is set after your first logged session

progression.attentionHint: This load cannot be built from your gym’s plates. Edit the target for today, or update your gym’s equipment.
progression.usingPlan: You chose the plan’s numbers for this session.
progression.usingManual: You edited this set; your numbers win over later suggestions.
progression.usePlanHint: Only unfinished sets in this session change.
progression.editGymHint: Plates, bar and increments used for rounding
progression.editPlanHint: Lasting changes to sets, reps and progression rules

descriptions.automatic: Musclog suggests each session from how the last one went. You can always undo it.
descriptions.double_progression: Work within a rep range. When every set hits the top, add weight and start again at the bottom.
descriptions.linear: Same reps every time. Add weight after a session where you got them all; deload after repeated misses.
descriptions.top_set_backoff: One heavy top set worked through a rep range, then lighter back-off sets at a share of it.
descriptions.percentage: Every set at a percentage of a training max that goes up after each successful session and drops after repeated misses.

progression.tmEstimated: The training max is estimated from your last session until you set one.
progression.holdHint: Same targets as last time. Beat them, or match them with reps to spare, and they go up next time.
progression.holdHintList: Where nothing changed, the targets are last time’s. Beat them, or match them with reps to spare, and they go up next time.

trainingFlow.restDay: No workout scheduled today. Choose one from your library.
trainingFlow.detailsHint: Optional. Leave effort empty if you did not rate this set.
trainingFlow.setTapHint: Tap “Last time” to repeat it, or a set number for effort, partial reps or to skip it.
trainingFlow.allDoneHint: Finish the workout to save it and see what changes next time.
trainingFlow.saveError: That change was not saved. Check the values and try again.
trainingFlow.adjustedHint: Calculated by your progression. Type to change it for this session.
trainingFlow.rotationNext: Longest since you trained it · last done {{date}}

weeklyReview.title: Weekly Review
weeklyReview.error: Unable to save or load the review. Your decision has not been completed. Try again.
weeklyReview.trainingHint: Reviewing never delays progression. Pick how your workouts start next week; you can still adjust any exercise in a session.
weeklyReview.noWorkout: Choose a workout or rotating plan in Workouts.
weeklyReview.collectData: Keep targets while collecting more data. To apply a recommendation, log food on at least {{food}} days and your weight on at least {{weight}} days of this week.
weeklyReview.empiricalReason: Recommendation uses historical intake and trend-weight expenditure, combined with your goal trajectory.
weeklyReview.baselineReason: Formula-based baseline estimate. More history is needed to estimate expenditure from your logs.
weeklyReview.noGoal: Training is available without a nutrition goal. Set nutrition goals in your profile when ready.
weeklyReview.intuitive: Intuitive eating is on. Your training review remains available.
weeklyReview.reminderBody: Your week is ready to review. Check training and nutrition targets.
weeklyReview.cardHint: Training recap and next week’s targets
weeklyReview.switchWeeklyHint: Weekly targets stay the same between reviews instead of changing every day.
weeklyReview.periodHint: The seven completed days before your review day
weeklyReview.reasonEmpirical: From your logs, you burn about {{expenditure}} kcal a day, and your trend weight changed {{change}} this week. These targets keep you on pace for your goal.
weeklyReview.reasonEmpiricalNoTrend: From your logs, you burn about {{expenditure}} kcal a day. These targets keep you on pace for your goal.
weeklyReview.reasonBaseline: Estimated from your profile, not yet from your logs: about {{expenditure}} kcal a day. Keep logging food and weight to personalize it.
weeklyReview.largeChangeBody: Changing calories by {{percent}}% in a single week is aggressive, and Musclog doesn’t recommend it. Big swings usually come from meals that weren’t logged or a few unusual weigh-ins, so check this week’s food log, or keep your current targets.

welcome.title: Welcome to your Weekly Review
welcome.subtitle: A short look back, and a plan for the week ahead.
welcome.training: Training: what you did last week, the records you set, and what comes next. Workout targets keep updating on their own.
welcome.nutrition: Nutrition: your intake and weight trend compared with your targets, and a recommendation for the coming week.
welcome.control: You decide: nothing changes until you apply it. A new review is ready every {{weekday}}.

empty.firstWorkout: Your workouts will show up here, with any records you set.
empty.firstMeal: Log your meals and weigh in a few times. Your review then recommends targets from what actually happened.
empty.firstReviewOn: Your first review will be ready on {{date}}.

progress.title: Keep progressing
progress.description: Each exercise starts where your last session says you're ready for.

repeat.title: Repeat last session
repeat.description: Each exercise starts with the weight and reps you did last time.

lighter.title: Lighter week
lighter.description: About 10% lighter loads and a third fewer sets, to recover.

goals.title: Your goals
goals.none: Set a fitness goal to see how each week measures up.

reasons.noWorkouts: No workouts this week, so next week picks up where you left off.
reasons.missedConsistency: You trained far less than your weekly goal; repeating avoids a sudden jump.
reasons.repeatedDeloads: {{count}} exercises needed a deload on their own this week.
reasons.lowReserveStalled: Your sets left nothing in reserve and a lift you're tracking has stalled.
reasons.dueForLighter: It has been {{count}} weeks since a lighter week.

weeklyReview.belowFloorBody: This is below your minimum of {{minimum}} kcal. You turned off the minimum calorie floor in Advanced settings; going this low is not recommended and may be unsafe.
